info.title: ipsla_responder
info.description: RESTful interface for AOS-CX switch software

ipsla_responder_statistics.description:
Reference Resource: [ipsla_responder_statistics](#/ipsla_responder_statistics)
Responder statistics for different IP SLA sources.

name.description:
Reference Resource: [ipsla_responder](#/ipsla_responder)
SLA name that uniquely identifies an IP SLA Responder.

persistence.description: Persistence of IPSLA session, i.e how the IP SLA session is provisioned: `persistent`   :  IP SLA session created by CLI or REST that will be retained                      over system reboot. `volatile`     :  IP SLA  session typically created by Aruba Central                      that will not be reatined over system reboot.

responder_interface.description:
Reference Resource: [Port](#/Port)
Interface for listening for IP SLA probes. If both responder_ip and responder_interface are provided responder_ip will be used. If both responder_ip or responder_interface are NOT provided, the responder listens on all L3 interfaces in a given VRF. This column value can be empty.

responder_ip.description: IP address for listening for IP SLA probes. If both responder_ip and responder_interface are provided responder_ip will be used. If both responder_ip or responder_interface are NOT provided, the responder listens on all L3 interfaces in a given VRF. This column value can be empty.

responder_port_number.description: TCP/UDP port number on which the responder needs to listen for the probes.

responder_type.description: The version of IP address used by the responder.

status.description: Running status of IP SLA responder: `not_running_yet`:    responder is configured, but not running yet. `running`:            responder is fully operational. `bind_failure`:       TCP or UDP port number is being used by some other service. `internal_error`:     unexpected error prevents responder operation.

type.description: Type of IP SLA: `udp_echo`:         responds to UDP echo probes. `tcp_connect`:      responds to TCP connect requests. `udp_jitter_voip`:  responds to UDP VOIP probes.

vrf.description:
Reference Resource: [VRF](#/VRF)
VRF on which the responder listens for IP SLA packets.

parameters.name: selector
parameters.description: Select configuration, status and/or statistics. Default is all categories.

parameters.name: filter
parameters.description: Filter rows by attribute values.  Format: attribute:value

parameters.name: count
parameters.description: Count the number of rows found.

parameters.name: If-None-Match
parameters.description: Entity-tag value for representation comparison (see RFC 7232 - Conditional Requests - section 3.2)
